# Local editing dependencies

These assets are served only from the studio's allowlist. No media or depth requests are sent to a provider.

- **Radiance**, FXTD Studios, version 3.5.4, commit `0174a5811b64665714a366b209cfd73d44418e91`: https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/tree/0174a5811b64665714a366b209cfd73d44418e91 . GPL-3.0-only, full license in `radiance/LICENSE.txt`. The adapted source is `../radiance-grade.js`, with the upstream credit and modification notice. No RUDRA weights or ComfyUI installation are included.
- **Transformers.js 3.8.1**, https://www.npmjs.com/package/@huggingface/transformers/v/3.8.1 . `depth-runtime/transformers.min.js` is the self-contained browser bundle from the npm tarball; Apache-2.0 in `depth-runtime/LICENSE.txt`. Its bundled ONNX Runtime Web version is `1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4`; runtime `.mjs` and `.wasm` are from the same tarball. ONNX Runtime MIT license is `depth-runtime/ONNX-LICENSE.txt`.
- **Depth Anything V2 Small (quantized ONNX)**, https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small/tree/4472b7362082ad9968fee890ca0f1e5aca36b93d . `onnx/model_quantized.onnx` and config files from this pinned revision. Underlying small model and source: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2 . Apache-2.0 in `depth-anything-v2-small/LICENSE.txt`. Local modification: the preprocessor dimensions are 280 × 280 (a multiple of 14), reduced from 518 × 518 for CPU browser inference. Aspect-ratio preservation, normalization and interpolation settings are unchanged. Captured input/depth maps are at most 256 pixels on the long edge.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` records the installed code, model and license hashes. Runtime/model files occupy approximately 47.5 MiB. Keep this directory with the app when copying it. The adapted GPL source and license must remain available when distributing this modified grading component; this notice does not relicense unrelated third-party components.

## MP4 export

**Mediabunny 1.62.1**, MPL-2.0, https://mediabunny.dev/ . `mediabunny/mediabunny.min.js` is the unmodified self-contained `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the official npm package, renamed for the local static server. The npm SHA-512 integrity was verified before installation. Full license: `mediabunny/LICENSE.txt`. Corresponding source and build information are included in the original package archive `mediabunny/mediabunny-1.62.1-source.tgz`; public source is also available at https://www.npmjs.com/package/mediabunny/v/1.62.1 . This library repackages H.264/AAC samples into a standard, indexed MP4; it does not send media anywhere or perform another lossy encode. Keep its license and corresponding source available when distributing the app.
